description: Morningscore is an SEO platform that provides domain, keyword, competitor, backlink, onsite health, GEO/AI-visibility, and AI writing data and tools. Its product is used to analyze website SEO performance and automate related workflows.
summary: Morningscore exposes two developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a bearer-token REST API at `https://api.morningscore.io` and a remote MCP server at `https://mcp.morningscore.io/mcp` that supports self-onboarding OAuth plus API-key header auth.
